caption: Frederiksborg Castle, Hillerød
composition: Red-brick castle and copper spires across Slotssøen · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the shore of the castle lake, Frederiksborg's red-brick Renaissance ranges and copper-green spires sit on the islets, with the dark water in the foreground. The night is partly cloudy, about 12.0°C, and the light wind only ripples the reflection. A few windows are warm. The baroque garden on the far side of the complex is not the subject of this lake view.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Frederiksborg Castle in Hillerød at night, seen across the castle lake
